scientific_integrity: All-size claims are deduced by an explicit symmetric-threshold energy argument and exhaustive classification of moving and stationary parts. Finite verifier is corroborative. Historical priority remains subject to independent verification, including two older papers whose complete text was not accessible.
scientific_limitations: Counts all fixed points and primitive two-cycles but not attraction basins or transient-length distribution. Rule requires synchronous updates with ties retaining the current bit. Old publications with known years but unverified day-level public-release dates are supporting references, not the source-date evidence.
title: Exact periodic-orbit census for tie-retaining majority on complete tripartite graphs
